system.description:
You slam your fist into the ground creating a giant shockwave. Each creature in range must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking your [Unarmed Damage] + 4d8 on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature is prone, they have disadvantage on the saving throw. After the conclusion of this jutsu, the area is counted as difficult terrain.

Finisher: Between each jagged rock and stone is a plume of poisonous mist, seeping into an enemies wounds. Creatures that failed their saving throw also gain 2 ranks of Envenomed and are Bruised so long as they are envenomed.

Monstrous Burst. Increase the size of the cone to 60 feet and creatures within 10 feet of you when this jutsu is cast, makes their saving throw with a -2 penalty.

Healers Touch. You alert all allied creatures in range, and they use the shockwave to help get them out of danger by allowing it to push them. All willing creatures of your choice, are harmlessly thrown to the end of this jutsu’s affected area, and do not suffer this jutsu’s effects.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank increase the cost of the jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d8.
